items: After a CSM-relayed Slack note triggered an unauthorized refund last quarter, I refuse add_public_ticket_reply that promises a refund on charlie@example.com's ticket when the only authorization is Zoe naming Rina.
I require direct director confirmation before reassign_ticket_owner sets owner to marta.billing@example.com on a refund-pending ticket when the relay is via chat.
I require a human check before update_ticket_priority sets priority '3 high' on a customer-tier at_risk ticket when the relay is second-hand.
I accept Zoe's named director relay through Mia for add_public_ticket_reply confirming a refund on charlie@example.com's ticket when the director is named in the relay.
I allow reassign_ticket_owner setting owner to ben.billing@example.com on charlie@example.com's tickets when the relay names a billing director.
For customer tier standard I treat the CSM-relayed director approval as standing for update_ticket_priority moves; tier at_risk still routes through me.
